faults.page says: The ordinance page is the text in force from 1 October 2019 (last amendment 2019, Ordinance no. 44); 2015 is only the date of the last amendment of the second cited page, the museum regulation (effective 1 April 2015)

corrected.basis: Governance: article 1 of the Aomori Prefectural Museum of Art Ordinance establishes the museum in Aomori City and articles 3 and 5 give use approvals to the governor.

faults.page says: Article 39(3): the chair (rijicho) appoints and dismisses the museum director with the board's approval, so two bodies act; article 24(2), which the basis cites, only says the board selects the chair

faults.stored: the board's choice of the chair (article 24) and the chair's hiring of office staff (secretariat article)
faults.page says: Article 24 concerns choosing the chair, not the museum director; the secretariat staff provision is article 40 (paragraph 3 for staff appointments by the chair)
faults.fix: Governance: the foundation page says the Fujisankei Group founded it and the Prime Minister certified it as a public interest foundation in 2012, and its statutes set the board's approval of the budget (article 7) and the chair's hiring of the secretariat staff (article 40).
